summary: Tungray Technologies filed a Form 6-K disclosing that Chairman, Director and CEO Wanjun Yao resigned effective September 14, 2026, citing personal reasons and no disagreement over operations, policies or practices. On September 15 the board appointed Liling Du, currently deputy general manager for finance and administration at subsidiaries Tungray Singapore and Tung Resource, as Interim CEO effective September 18; an offer letter is attached. Du is Yao's spouse, a related-party and governance consideration. No price, stake or premium terms apply; watch succession timing, disclosure controls, and whether a permanent CEO search or strategic shift follows.
